---
title: "Search"
description: "Search the articles, guides and pages on AI+."
include-in-header:
  text: '<link rel="stylesheet" href="/pagefind/pagefind-ui.css">'
---

```{=html}
<div id="search" class="site-search"></div>
<noscript><p>Search needs JavaScript. Without it, browse the <a href="/articles/">articles</a>, the <a href="/guides/">guides and labs</a> or the <a href="/handbooks/">handbooks</a>.</p></noscript>
<script src="/pagefind/pagefind-ui.js"></script>
<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var ui = new PagefindUI({
      element: '#search',
      baseUrl: '/',
      showSubResults: true,
      showImages: false,
      autofocus: true,
      translations: { placeholder: 'Search AI+' }
    });
    (function label() {
      var input = document.querySelector('#search input');
      if (input) { input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Search AI+'); } else { window.requestAnimationFrame(label); }
    })();
    var q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('q');
    if (q) { ui.triggerSearch(q); }
  });
</script>
```

[Search covers this site. The handbooks have their own search on their own sites.]{.ai-small}
